Fix round 2026-09-30: two labels only. 'Example' (copy example.chip) for real engine artwork, 'AI visualisation' (copy example.vis) for every mock-up; the eyes that are not Mantas's are called 'Example photo, not a customer' (copy example.photoFull), which claims no licence type.

m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).what: AI-generated room plates (Gemini, generated 2026-09-30 on the owner's account, 80 plates screened; no model call was made for this page) with SnapEyes artwork composed in locally with numpy and PIL: plate mode of mockups/mock.py, the canvas and aluminium looks of mock_fx.py, the 11 scenes of landing assets V3 (assets_v3/rooms: author.py, build_scenes_v3.py, build_rooms.py) plus the older hands, shelf, oblique gallery, desk, phone, macro and hero plates re-composited with the final artworks
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).rooms per material: acrylic: living room; aluminium: home office; canvas: sunlit hall; framed: sand room. Each of these has a square plate (one eye) and a 3:2 plate of the same room (pair, family). Block and phone: desk. Hero: lounge. More ways to see it: pair (walnut cafe), group (white gallery wall, framed), hands, gallery angle (pair), shelf. Closing scene: dusk study on acrylic. Edge close-up: macro corner
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).grade: daylight plates (living, office, hall, hotel, gallery, and the older hands, shelf, oblique gallery and desk) share mock_fx.grade with the wall next to the piece at sRGB luminance 0.70; the dusk plates (study, cafe) keep their lamp light; hero, phone and macro as before
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).artworks: eye = Radiance single of own215120 (final round 2c, 4096 px); universe = Universe, Echo look, of own215120 (final, 4096 px); collision = Collision Infinity of own215120 + drv_w04 (4096 px); family4 = Infinity Chain of four irises, own215120 + drv_w04 + drv_w03 + drv_d01 (3:2, 1024 px, padded on black where the plate is square). The tile chip br was changed to w06 because w03 fails the single-eye input gate; the chain is the round 2c board's final render and still carries w03 (re-render with w06 if the two should match)
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).sizes: a size caption (about 50 cm) only where the drawn size was estimated at 40 to 55 cm: hero, canvas pair and family (hall 3:2), framed single and Universe (hotel). Estimated on a gridded copy against objects of known size, plus or minus 15 to 25 percent; every anchor is in the scene registry
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).rights: artworks as above; plates generated by the owner's Gemini account, the hands plate shows a generic person (no face)
m/* (rooms, hands, desk, phone, macro).label: visualisation
